facility.name: Little Rascals
facility.programs_provided: Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 2240 CLARKSVILLE ST, PARIS, TX, 75460

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training-Self-Instructional 80%: One caregiver lacked 4 hours of instructor-led training to completed the required 5 hours of instructor-led training for last year's annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training-Self-Instructional 80% (26 TAC §746.1309(g))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: The operation did not have attendance records or time sheets listing all days and hours worked for the director for the past three months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: One door in the center that leads to the playground does not shut properly and needs to be repaired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: One caregiver lacked 5 hours required instructor-led training to complete last years annual training and four hours training to complete last years annual training. This was corrected at inspection as moved three two hour instructor-led trainings from the current training year to complete last years annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: The operational policies lacked a written procedure for supporting inclusive services to children with special care needs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training: The director lacked six hours training to complete last years annual training as well as the required 6 hours of instructor-led training to complete last years annyal training. This was corrected at inspection as moved 6 hours instructor-led traiing from the director's current annual training year to complete last years annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Substitutes, volunteers, and contractors counted in ratio: A volunteer who does not meet caregiver qualifications was counted in ratio during nap time in one classroom while the director was supervising a sick child in the office.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Substitutes, volunteers, and contractors counted in ratio (26 TAC §746.1401(c))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: The changing mat in one classtoom was observed torn. This prevents it from being able to be properly sanitized. This was corrected at inspection as the operation replaced the changing mat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: One caregivers record lacked documentation of completion of 6 hours training to complete last years annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: The children records evaluated did not have documentation showing the parents have been informed of the parents rights.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant: Two pack-n-plays in which children nap in the infant room were not labeled with the children's names nor name/number assignment. This was corrected at inspection as staff labeled the pack-n-plays.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's record lacked emergency care authorization. One child's record lacked documentation that the parents received a copy of the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: One employee's personnel record lacked a notarized Licensing Affidavit for Applicants for Employment form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment: The use zone are not being met between the playhouse and the Merry Go Cycle. The use zones are not being met between the Little Tikes slide and Little Tikes gym.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §746.4803)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: There is a playhouse on the playground that structure is coming apart posing as a potential hazard as could collapse. There are large sticks on the playground that need to be removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: During an audit of staff records one of four was lacking training in emergency preparedness, preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases and understanding building and physical premises safety.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Required 6 hours: During an audit of the director's training records out of their 64 hours completed they were lacking 3 of the required 6 hours in topic area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Required 6 hours (26 TAC §746.1311(b))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: During an audit of the director's training records out of the 64 hours completed they were lacking required training in Understand building and physical premises safety and Handling, storing and disposing of hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Address and Phone Number: During an audit of children's files one of five children's files reviewed was lacking a complete adress for their home address.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Address and Phone Number (26 TAC §746.605(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: During an audit of children's files it was observed that one of five children's files reviewed was lacking a complete address for their emergency contact person.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: During an audit of staff records one of four caregivers was lacking training for their previous training year in SIDS, Shaken Baby and Brain Development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))
